title: Teacher Mrs. Anna Stewart
summary: She credits Mrs. Anna Stewart, a New England Conservatory graduate, with her foundation in harmony, theory and thoroughbass.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Who were your teachers? Did you have many teachers?

I had various teachers, but the one to whom I give all credit was a Mrs. Stewart, because she gave me a foundation and a basic that one gets in college now. Transposition and Thoroughbass and Harmony, Theory, and all of that I had under her. And you don't get that until you advance, but she gave me a thoroughbass. So I give her all of the credit. I've had various teachers, but I give her the credit. And what's her full name? Her name is Mrs. Anna Stewart. She was a graduate of the New England Conservatory of Music. But she isn't playing anymore. Of course, she's old now. But she stopped quite some years ago. She was very good.
Is she still in the past?

No. I think she lives here. I'm not sure. But she moved from there after, oh, for quite a few years, quite a few years ago. And came over here to live. But I think she's back in the past, and I'm not too sure about where she's located. But she stopped playing. And stopped teaching also.
Did she play with bands? No.
She never did play with a band.
Just a music teacher. And a very good one.
